title: Elevator machinery noise control in multiple dwellings.
officialText: Gear-driven machinery, gearless machinery, and motor generators located in an elevator machinery room or shaft on a roof, or on a floor other than a floor on grade, shall be supported on vibration isolator pads having a minimum thickness of ½ inch (12.7 mm).
